title: An assembly line of processes
summary: N processes joined by N+1 pipes: close the right ends, and the end of the data travels down the line.
hints: Create all N+1 pipes BEFORE the forks: worker `k` reads from pipe `k-1` and writes to pipe `k`. The parent writes into pipe 0 and reads from pipe N.

Every process must close every pipe end it does not use. If any copy of a write end stays open somewhere (the parent's too), the processes after it never see the end of the data and the program hangs.
`read(fd, &v, sizeof v) == sizeof v` is the loop condition of a worker; at the end of the data `read` returns `0`.
The array of pipes: `int (*p)[2] = malloc((n + 1) * sizeof *p);`
